decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with recent development investment, the firm is likely to continue with it for now, though the weaker public commitment implied by only a website mention makes it somewhat easier to withdraw than the others.

A large, established German machinery firm that gave this product its own webpage has signaled visible commitment and will tend to justify that investment by keeping it on the market unless results become clearly untenable.
Because the firm publicly highlighted this printer on its own page and has only recently launched it, escalation of commitment makes continued support more likely than an early withdrawal.
